capabilities: Export bots to Telegram or other chat services and choose who may talk to them.
description: Stop exporting a bot to a chat service immediately and delete the export's stored credentials. kind is how the bot is exported, "telegram" or "bridge"; botId is the exported bot. Existing conversation subtasks and guests stay in Happy. A bridge token stops working and the bridge's unsent replies are discarded. To pause instead, use set_telegram_exported_bot or set_bridge_exported_bot with enabled false.

botId.description: The ID of the Happy bot that is exported, from list_bots.

kind.description: The kind of export to remove, "telegram" or "bridge"

name: remove_exported_bot
